import json
import urllib.request
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
targets = [
    "https://api.bourseview.com",
    "https://api.bourseview.com/swagger",
    "https://api.bourseview.com/swagger/index.html",
    "https://api.bourseview.com/openapi.json",
    "https://api.bourseview.com/swagger/v1/swagger.json",
    "https://api.bourseview.com/v2",
    "https://www.bourseview.com/views/api.html"
]
results = []
for url in targets:
    item = {"url": url}
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "OptimusAI-connectivity-check/1.0", "Accept": "application/json,text/html,*/*"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as response:
            raw = response.read(1800)
            item["status"] = response.status
            item["final_url"] = response.geturl()
            item["content_type"] = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
            item["body_preview"] = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:700]
    except HTTPError as exc:
        item["status"] = exc.code
        item["error"] = "HTTPError"
        item["body_preview"] = exc.read(500).decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except Exception as exc:
        item["error"] = type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)
    results.append(item)
print(json.dumps({"probe": "bourseview_connectivity", "results": results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
